notes.title: School Fighter is here!
notes.content:
[h1]School Fighter Launch![/h1]

We’re excited to announce that [i]School Fighter[/i] has just launched on Steam and is fully ready to play!

Alongside the release, we’ve also published the #DayOnePatch update, fixing a few issues discovered in the first hours after launch.

[h2]Patch 1.01:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with certain Steam achievements not being properly registered,
[*] Made minor adjustments to the "level up" screen,
[*] Added a few new soundtracks,
[*] Improved balance in some boss fights.
[/list]

Lastly, we have a small request for you! Share your feedback with us at [b]contact@sheep-games.com[/b] and take part in the active development of School Fighter!
